title: Apollo telemetry data and original footage destroyed
summary: Joe Rogan tells of Apollo telemetry data and original footage destroyed, about 1969 at NASA, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Also, the all the telemetry data was destroyed, which is crazy.

plain: A podcast host, Joe Rogan, speaking on another host's show, talks about the Apollo missions, NASA's flights to the Moon around 1969. Rogan says that all the telemetry data, the stream of measurements sent back from the spacecraft, was destroyed along with original footage, and he calls that crazy. If true, it would mean key records of the Moon landings no longer exist.
